data_description.host: Pick a unit found on this network, or type an IP address or hostname.
data_description.port: The Tide16's WebSocket port. Leave this alone unless you have changed it on the unit.

reconfigure.title: Update miniDSP Tide16 connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address if the Tide16 moved on your network.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from that address. The Tide16 leaves the network in standby, so wake it and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Tide16 is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one miniDSP Tide16 can be configured.

init.title: Audio detection and updates
init.description: The output meters are measured after the master volume, so Audio Signal compares the programme level (peak minus volume) to a threshold. If it turns off during quiet passages, lower that threshold; if it never turns off, raise it.

data.silence_level: Fallback level while the volume is unknown
data.update_check: Check for firmware updates every hour

data_description.signal_relative_level: Peak output level minus the master volume. -60 dB keeps quiet classical music detected at low volume.
data_description.silence_level: Used only until the unit has reported its volume. Run the "Measure output level" action with nothing playing to see your noise floor.
data_description.silence_hold: How long nothing may be heard before Audio Signal turns off. Audio starting is reported immediately.
data_description.update_check: Off by default: while it checks, the unit reports "Reaching update server..." for up to a minute. The Check for update button asks on demand.
